name: ROBOTIS Co., Ltd.
summary: ROBOTIS Co., Ltd. provides robotic solutions in South Korea. It provides autonomous indoor robot that offers small goods delivery to residential spaces and office complexes; autonomous outdoor robot for parcel and food delivery service; robot actuators under Dynamixel brand name; cycloid gear under the DYNAMIXEL DRIVE; and open source robots. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
